## Purpose
Global stylesheet. `index.css` pulls in the Tailwind layers and sets scrollbar styling, body font and heading/base tweaks. It is imported once by `gitprofile.tsx` in [[src-components]].

## Key concepts
- `index.css` starts with `@tailwind base/components/utilities`, then custom scrollbar rules and the `body` font (`Nova Round`).

## Gotchas
- The `Nova Round` font is loaded from Google Fonts in `index.html`, not here; without it the body falls back to cursive.
